test_item:
The software shall provide a Binder-based interface via the Android Java Service to allow external components (specifically the DIAG service) to query the current key installation status.
(installation completed; the status is INSTALLED (2))
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Key installation has completed successfully on the DUT
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
2. PENDING: X-f KeyInstall status test runner
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 output shows the installstate value 2
2. PENDING: X-f KeyInstall status test runner
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-011 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria 1.1 and 3.1 (Binder getStatus verbatim)
RD ID spelling as delivered
The installstate file name is a placeholder: 037 states the secure partition but not the file name. DID 22 FF 02 is a supplementary observation only and is not a pass/fail criterion; the two-state versus four-state question is open
